official.application_cycle: Sub-programme calls open on their own dates; current calls listed on the official umbrella page (including 2025/2026 and 2026/2027 cycles) are marked 'Plazo cerrado'
official.status_note: The official umbrella page lists the current sub-programme announcements and the 2025/2026 MASTER sub-programme page is marked 'Plazo cerrado'; the next cycle is upcoming.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The published 'Dotacion' for the MASTER sub-programme consists of a monthly stipend and health insurance in Spain; tuition fees are not listed as part of the award on the pages reviewed.
benefits: Health insurance / medical assistance in Spain ('seguro de asistencia sanitaria en España')
eligibility: Sub-programme-specific citizenship: some programmes are for young Spaniards (COE, CULT, COOPERACION), others for citizens of Latin America, Africa, the Middle East, the Philippines and Ukraine (MASTER, ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA, ASALE, MUSICA, ROMAIB)
MASTER sub-programme targets fixed, non-temporary civil servants and public employees, including education and university system staff
Minimum study level stated per call, e.g. 'Licenciado/Grado' for MASTER
requirements: Applications are filed through the AECID electronic registry (Sede electronica AECID, www.aecid.gob.es)
The complete bases and annexes are published in each sub-programme's Convocatoria
The MASTER 2025/2026 call required applications by 13:00 Madrid time on the closing day
selection_criteria: Selection rules are set in each sub-programme's Convocatoria (bases and annexes); the umbrella page does not publish a common scoring scheme
application_method: Telematic application via the AECID Electronic Office (Sede electronica AECID), within each sub-programme's application window
official.application_route: Watch the official Becas y Lectorados page for the next Convocatoria, then apply electronically through the AECID Electronic Office during that sub-programme's window.
official.citizenship_residency: Sub-programme-specific: Spanish citizenship for some calls; citizenship of listed partner countries in Latin America, Africa, the Middle East, the Philippines and Ukraine for others
official.international_eligibility: Non-Spanish applicants are eligible only in designated sub-programmes (e.g. MASTER, ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA, MUSICA, ASALE, ROMAIB)
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Each sub-programme is tied to a defined field and public-sector audience (e.g. MASTER targets civil servants for university master's study in Spain; ESCUELA DIPLOMATICA funds the Master in Diplomacy and International Relations)
official.description: The MAEC-AECID 'Becas Cooperacion Espanola' programme family is run by the Spanish Agency for International Development Cooperation and funds training for Spanish citizens and for citizens of Spanish-cooperation partner countries. The official umbrella page groups the calls into scholarships for young Spaniards, readerships (Lectorados), scholarships for citizens of Latin America, Africa and Asia, and artistic or research residencies at the Real Academia de Espana en Roma; each sub-programme has its own Convocatoria, dates and benefits.
official.program_type: Government scholarship programme family (umbrella of sub-programmes)

verification.notes: Both the official umbrella page and the MASTER sub-programme page were fetched directly from aecid.es; neither publishes monetary award amounts, dates for the next cycle, or an English-language test requirement, so those fields remain null.

applicant_utility.summary: AECID is not one scholarship but a family of MAEC-AECID calls, so the single most important step is identifying which sub-programme your nationality and employment status actually open to you. As of verification, the listed calls are closed ('Plazo cerrado'), including the MASTER call that ran 20 February to 6 March 2025 for fixed civil servants. Each sub-programme publishes its own Convocatoria with its own bases, audience and dates, so monitor the official Becas y Lectorados page rather than any third-party aggregator.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Public-sector professionals (especially fixed civil servants from Latin America, the Philippines, Ukraine, Africa and the Middle East) and young Spanish applicants for diplomatic or cultural training
application_readiness_checklist: Match your citizenship and employment status to exactly one sub-programme before preparing documents
Check whether your employer status qualifies (MASTER, for example, is limited to fixed, non-temporary civil servants)
Read the full Convocatoria PDF for your sub-programme on the AECID Electronic Office, since bases and annexes differ between calls
Prepare for a Spanish-language application and documentation set
File electronically through the AECID Electronic Office early in the window; the MASTER call closed at 13:00 Madrid time
common_rejection_risks: Applying to the wrong sub-programme for your nationality or employment status
Treating a closed cycle as live and missing the next call entirely
Assuming the umbrella page's general description applies to your call when the Convocatoria sets the real rules
Missing a midday (13:00 Madrid) cutoff that differs from the usual midnight deadlines
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Published support is a monthly stipend plus health insurance in Spain; with no published amount and no tuition or travel entitlement confirmed, applicants should budget for tuition, travel and living costs themselves unless their specific Convocatoria states otherwise.
document_audit: Requirements are annexed to each Convocatoria, so document lists from previous years or aggregators may not match the current call
Employment status must be evidenced for public-servant programmes; temporary contracts do not qualify for the MASTER line
alerts: The listed 2025/2026 and 2026/2027 calls are marked 'Plazo cerrado'; the next cycle dates are not yet published
AECID has posted notices about scheduled website maintenance affecting application periods, so do not file at the last hour
This catalogue row is an umbrella record: award value, dates and rules differ substantially between sub-programmes
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Watch the official umbrella page for the next Convocatoria, read that sub-programme's bases on the AECID Electronic Office, then file electronically within its window.
